title: Covenants and Cutting
summary: Ancient covenants often involved solemn promises, witnesses, signs, sacrifices, or covenant meals.
background: Biblical covenants are not casual promises. They involve binding commitment, divine witness, and sometimes sacrificial signs that stress the seriousness of the oath.
teachingHelp: Covenant passages should be taught with weight: God binds Himself to His Word and calls His people to faithful response.
